title: Record a stub fixture from the Amadeus test environment
caption: Manual developer step (OBE-027, X-034); never in CI (refuses when CI is set) and never in production.

steps.title: Credentials
steps.body: `AMADEUS_RECORD_CLIENT_ID` and `AMADEUS_RECORD_CLIENT_SECRET` in the git-ignored `.env.local` (root or `tools/amadeus-stub`). Never on the command line.

steps.title: Request file
steps.body: Outside the repository, synthetic travellers only (`ALEX TESTER`, `person1@example.com`): `{ "query": {…}, "pathParams": {…}, "body": {…} }`.

steps.title: Record
steps.expect: Validated request, token, call, scrub, scan; writes `fixtures/<folder>/<scenario>.json`; prints counts, never values. Any scan finding stops it.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Read the file, list it in `fixtures/README.md`, run `pnpm --filter @velexis/amadeus-stub test`.
steps.expect: The fixture scan covers the new file.
